method: Fixed controller timestep, three walk samples, three run samples, three roll samples and one resting sample on both tiers. The separate raised-leg study uses the same production skin and inspection builder. Depth samples use six views, 448 pixels square and a tolerance of 0.020 in. Maximum ray depth difference includes air between separate body regions. It is not the nearest-surface penetration.

independentLowerBodySurfaceStudy.method: Proximal femur exterior positions, edge midpoints, and triangle centroids were compared to the nearest actual skin triangle independently of viewing direction. Garment corridor values come from the connected eroded interior of the posed, sewn trousers.
